reading_note: The teaching describes the regenerating soul's path home. Having been chosen out of affliction (the corrupting influence of every lower power), the soul finds no open passage in any of the natural or lower spiritual states — they are precisely what defiles her. Only through the two luminaries (celestial good — sun; spiritual truth — moon) does an open gate appear: these become her resting-place and her means of egress to "the house of her men," her true heavenly home. The arc then opens outward to a cosmic correspondence: just as the soul rests in the luminaries before her ascent, so the Land of Light itself is the final receiver of the luminaries — the celestial kingdom into which all received love and wisdom are gathered, where they rest and reign forever. The single arc is: deliverance from affliction → rest in love and truth → ascent home → eternal repose in the celestial.
